title: NACC Theatre

services.name: Space Rental
services.desc: The Northern Arts and Cultural Centre is a 297-seat theatre in Yellowknife, NT, with 4 additional wheelchair seating spots. The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and comfortable with a proscenium stage and fly system, vibrant red theatre seats, a foyer featuring work by Northern artists, and a concession with local brew from NWT Brewing Company. The venue hosts intimate performances, with the furthest seat being only 35 feet from the stage. Our backstage area is home to two dressing rooms with bathroom and shower facilities, and a renovated loading dock with ample storage space. Please note that the rental of the venue is subject to availability. For all rental inquires or questions, please
